verdict.rationale: Secureframe's vendor risk management module keeps an active vendor list, using SSO-based shadow IT detection to keep it current. It continuously monitors vendors' security posture, and Comply AI extracts security review answers from vendor SOC 2 reports and policies. It also supports recurring reviews scheduled by risk level, with Jira/Slack tasks and vendor updates surfaced in the dashboard. missing for 10: explicit evidence of tracking each vendor's data access or data classification, independent or hands-on corroboration of the vendor workflow.
